text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—The Spring Tenno Sho came to a close amid 
deafening cheers.

Super Creek, having defeated Tamamo Cross 
with an overwhelming performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though defeated by Tamamo Cross, Super 
Creek gave off an overwhelming, fearsome 
aura.

Tamamo Cross bore witness to Super Creek 
racing with absolute seriousness—a side 
she had never shown before—and...

It became clear that she had found a 
solid, unshakeable "reason to run."

Waiting for Super Creek in her next race, 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), was Oguri Cap.
